agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited financial statements, granting a full discharge of liability to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for the 2025 fiscal year. The financial statements were audited by Ernst & Young with an unqualified opinion.
Agenda #2: The meeting established that the total net profit of Rp3,501,154,166,119 for the 2025 fiscal year will be allocated entirely as Retained Earnings.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the majority Series B Shareholder and the Board of Commissioners to determine salaries, honorariums, facilities, and performance bonuses for the Board of Directors and Commissioners for FY 2025 and FY 2026.
Agenda #4: Shareholders approved the appointment of Ernst & Young (Purwanto, Susanti & Surja) to audit the 2026 Consolidated Financial Statements and the Micro and Small Business Funding Program (PUMK) reports.
Agenda #5: The Board of Commissioners was authorized, subject to written approval from the majority Series B Shareholder, to approve the 2026-2030 Long-Term Corporate Plan and the 2027 Corporate Budget.
Agenda #6: The meeting approved updates to the company's Recovery Plan to comply with OJK Regulation No. 5 of 2024 regarding bank supervision and problem handling.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved the implementation of a dual pension scheme for the BTN Pension Fund, consisting of both Defined Benefit and Defined Contribution programs.
Agenda #8: The meeting granted authority to the Board of Commissioners, subject to written approval from the majority Series B Shareholder, to acquire a credit portfolio from a national private bank.
Agenda #9: Shareholders approved the reclassification of 84,206,665 Series B shares into Series A Dwiwarna shares to comply with Law No. 16 of 2025.
Agenda #10: This agenda item served as a report on the use of funds from Social Bonds and Subordinated Bonds Phase I 2025, and no voting or decision was required.
Agenda #11: The meeting reappointed Nofry Rony Poetra and Eko Waluyo as Directors, appointed Endra Gunawan as Vice President Commissioner, and confirmed the discharge of Dwi Ary Purnomo.

agm.agm_result: Agenda #1: Change of Management (Perubahan Pengurus Perseroan). The Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders, held on a date stated as 4 September 2026, 4 August 2026, or 7 September 2026 across summaries, approved the dismissal of five directors and the appointment of five new directors, with the new composition of the Board of Directors (12 members) and Board of Commissioners (7 members) as listed. The meeting, attended by shareholders representing 74.1015672% of voting shares, passed the resolution with 86.6981198% of votes in favor, and also resolved that appointed directors shall perform duties per OJK regulations, submit a Fit and Proper Test application, resign from prohibited concurrent positions, and granted authority to formalize the resolutions; no questions or proposals were raised.
